answer: Witness Rotation Quorum: an account counts only after live witnesses confirm it. Each epoch 7 witnesses are drawn by stake age, and a pulse check goes to each candidate, needing a distinct machine reply. Cost: 1 fake identity needs 1 machine, about 5 USD a month and 50 POA bond; 10 fake identities cost 50 USD and 500 POA; 100 fake identities cost 500 USD and 5000 POA. An honest user pays once. A crystal ledger lists every reply and the invite vine caps 5 per sponsor; 10 percent are audited and liars lose the bond. Limit: rented cloud machines can pass.
